title: Open a group link
summary: What a bipe.chat/g/<code> link does on a phone with an account (ADR 0184, bipe-chat/bipe#744): shows the group and puts the person in it with one tap. A phone with no account takes the code into sign-up like an invite link.

code.description: The code from the link (extractInviteCode). Never shown and never logged.

phase.description: loading: GET /v1/group-links/{code}. preview: the group. joining: join runs. invalid: valid false or a 404 on join, bipe_group_link_open_invalid. failed: bipe_error_network with bipe_app_retry; a 409 shows bipe_app_room_link_invite_only.

inviterName.description: GroupLinkPreview.inviter_name, in bipe_group_link_open_invited_by. Hidden when absent.

open.effect: Reads the code and runs the preview. Phase preview or invalid.

join.effect: POST /v1/group-links/{code}/join, then Client.joinRoomById with the room ID. Success opens chat-timeline for the room and closes. A room the person is already in opens at once.

close.effect: Closes and goes back to where the user was.

notes: Where a link comes from: the universal link https://bipe.chat/g/<code> (iOS associated domains, Android app link), and a tapped link in a message, like invite links.

A phone with no account: onboarding takes the code like an invite code (signup-invite-code, extractInviteCode). POST /v1/signup with the group code answers group_room_id; after sign-in the app runs Client.joinRoomById with it and opens the group. A link that does not sign people up gives invite_invalid at sign-up, as an unusable invite.
A link that arrives before sign-in waits until account-start ends, then opens, like room-link-open.

Default chosen (bipe-chat/bipe#744): no list of contacts who are already in the group, because the preview never returns member names. It can come after the person joins, from the room members. mz can overrule.
